a.lede: To follow Elon Musk’s America PAC money, WIRED created a live-updating tracker that highlights the trillionaire’s overall influence on November’s elections.
a.title: Elon Musk’s America PAC Is Spending Big on the Midterms. We’re Tracking It Daily

b.lede: America PAC’s approach has been unusual: for every dollar it has spent supporting GOP Senate candidates, it has spent almost three dollars attacking Democrats.
b.title: Elon Musk’s America PAC Is Quietly Funding November’s Most Consequential Elections
